results.name: ZMod.val_injective
results.source_text:
theorem val_injective (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : Function.Injective (val : ZMod n → ℕ) := by
  cases n
  · cases NeZero.ne 0 rfl
  intro a b h
  dsimp [ZMod]
  ext
  exact h

results.name: ZMod
results.source_text:
/-- The integers modulo `n : ℕ`. -/
@[to_additive_dont_translate]
def ZMod : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => ℤ
  | n + 1 => Fin (n + 1)

results.name: ZMod.val
results.source_text:
/-- `val a` is a natural number defined as:
  - for `a : ZMod 0` it is the absolute value of `a`
  - for `a : ZMod n` with `0 < n` it is the least natural number in the equivalence class

See `ZMod.valMinAbs` for a variant that takes values in the integers.
-/
def val : ∀ {n : ℕ}, ZMod n → ℕ
  | 0 => Int.natAbs
  | n + 1 => ((↑) : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ)

theorem val_lt {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (a : ZMod n) : a.val < n := by

results.name: ZMod.val_cast_zmod_lt
results.source_text:
theorem val_cast_zmod_lt {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (a : ZMod m) :
    (a.cast : ZMod n).val < m := by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne m)
  by_cases! h : m < n
  · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
    rw [← natCast_val, val_cast_of_lt]
    · apply a.val_lt
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ZMod.val_lt a)) h
  · apply lt_of_lt_of_le (ZMod.val_lt _) (le_trans h (Nat.le_succ m))

results.name: Set.Subsingleton
results.source_text:
/-- A set `s` is a `Subsingleton` if it has at most one element. -/
protected def Subsingleton (s : Set α) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x⦄ (_ : x ∈ s) ⦃y⦄ (_ : y ∈ s), x = y
results.docstring: A set `s` is a `Subsingleton` if it has at most one element.

results.name: Finset.subset_singleton_iff'
results.source_text:
theorem subset_singleton_iff' {s : Finset α} {a : α} : s ⊆ {a} ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, b = a :=
  forall₂_congr fun _ _ => mem_singleton

results.source_text:
lemma subsingleton_of_subsingleton_inter_left (h : (s ∪ t).Subsingleton) :
    s.Subsingleton :=
  fun _ h₁ _ h₂ ↦ h (.inl h₁) (.inl h₂)
